sub: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts across the Texas science TEKS — from light & shadows in Kindergarten to conservation of mass in Grade 8. Each grade page holds a featured breakout, a set of short concept breakouts (one per key idea), a hands-on STEM engineering design challenge, and a student word bank. Choose a grade to begin.
foot: For teachers: each grade page includes a lock-by-lock TEKS correlation, the misconceptions targeted, a printable STEM engineering design challenge, a student word bank, and a password-protected answer key — all in seven languages (use the 🌐 menu at the top). See the standards correlation guide (all 99 breakouts mapped to the TEKS), the development guide for the full grades 1–8 roadmap, and the teacher supports pages — UDL, ELPS, and a lesson-plan guide — each in all seven languages. Standards are aligned to, not reproduced from, the 2021 Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills for Science — confirm before adoption.
footer: Science Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · Self-contained, no logins, no data collected. · Privacy & compliance
